title: Hosted API mini-lab portrait assets
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact set of portrait-oriented UX screenshots and annotated assets for the Hosted API quickstart 'mini-lab' that will be used in the docs quickstart, in-product first-run modal, and a short marketing hero. Focus is mobile-first portrait frames (375x812 and 390x844) plus one responsive desktop capture for reference. Screens should highlight: model selector with latency/cost badges, interactive request builder (system+user+assistant slots), streaming toggle, structured-output example (JSON schema), and live code snippets (curl, Python, JS) with copy buttons. Deliverables must be optimized for retina display and exported with transparent overlay variants for compositing into marketing slides.
screens: Welcome mini-card: single-step microcopy explaining mini-lab purpose and ephemeral demo token CTA
Model picker: compact list view with model tile, small latency + cost badge, and compatibility indicator for streaming/function-calling
Request builder: stacked system/user fields, token estimate meter, streaming toggle, run button with spinning indicator state
Live result: streaming output shown line-by-line with JSON-structured output example and schema validation badge
Code panel: three tabs (curl, python, javascript) with copy button and small inlined example that mirrors the request builder state
Share / copy snippet modal: shows ephemeral demo token and link to full docs
acceptance_criteria: All 6 screens exported at @2x in PNG with correct artboard sizes and safe margins
SVG annotation overlay matches redlines and is pixel-aligned to artboards
Code snippets reflect current API surface (streaming boolean, model param, input schema) and copy buttons work in the sample harness
Design tokens used match product CSS variables; exported assets include token map for engineers
Accessibility: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for primary text and interactive elements in both light and dark variants
PM and Eng sign-off on runtime demo token requirements and immutability of example model identifiers
reviewer_feedback: PM (Ravi Patel): please make model cost badges slightly less prominent than latency to avoid pricing anxiety in early experience
Eng (Ivy Morales): need a note that demo tokens do not expose production endpoints; include a placeholder for telemetry opt-in
Design Lead (Evelyn Park): tighten vertical rhythm on request builder, reduce line-height in snippet panel to avoid truncation
Docs (Samira Khan): prefer full curl example first, then language SDKs; keep snippets under 6 lines
follow_up_tasks: Finalize copy for demo token modal and pass to legal for short form consent
Export additional dark-mode contrast tweaks and deliver token map to frontend
Create scaled marketing hero (1920x1080) using overlay assets
Schedule screenshot capture session with QA to verify runtime consistency across regions
notes: Avoid reusing phrasing from existing quickstart assets; this mini-lab should read as a standalone hands-on micro-tutorial
Prefer descriptive microcopy for the run button: 'Run demo' instead of generic 'Submit'
Keep sample prompts neutral and industry-agnostic to reduce compliance review scope
